items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: I don't know too much of where Hightower.

ctx.x: They were from all over town, but they used to. Most of them from downtown, wouldn't want to come up town. The most of town wouldn't want to go downtown.
Did Willie Hightower live around there? Did you ever know him? Willie Hightower. For the Hightower. The Hightower.
The Hightower. I don't know too much of where Hightower. I always think. Oh, Mom!
